scripts.text:
[Ghatu]
I've heard of a strange
blacksmith who lives in
seclusion deep in the
Payon Forest. The man
was once famous for his
legendary smithing skill...
scripts.translation:
[加圖]
我聽說在斐揚樹林深處，隱居著一位奇怪的鐵匠。此人曾以傳奇般的鍛造技藝聞名於世...

scripts.text:
[Ghatu]
Rumor has it that he's
hiding in the mountains
since too many people want to use his talents for the wrong
purposes. Apparently, there is a godly quality to his weapons...
scripts.translation:
[加圖]
傳聞他因為太多人想利用他的技藝做壞事，所以躲進了山裡。據說他打造的武器有著神一般的質量...

scripts.text:
[Ghatu]
Remember that blacksmith
I told you about last time? It
seems that his weapons were
in such great demand because
he would enchant them with 
tremendously powerful magic.
scripts.translation:
[加圖]
還記得我之前跟你提過的那位鐵匠嗎？他的武器之所以如此搶手，是因為他會用極其強大的魔法為武器附魔。

scripts.text:
[Ghatu]
However, the man was forced
by the power hungry and the
oppressive to create weapons
for selfish and immoral ends.
It's no surprise that he went
into hiding in the end...
scripts.translation:
[加圖]
然而，他被迫為那些貪婪且專橫的人制造武器，用於自私且不道德的目的。最後他選擇隱居，這並不令人意外...

scripts.text:
[Ghatu]
It's sad, really.
That smith used to be
a pretty easy going guy
until he was forced to work
against his will. Slowly, he became gloomy and intimidating...
scripts.translation:
[加圖]
真令人難過。
那位鐵匠原本是個挺隨和的傢伙，直到被迫違背意願工作。慢慢地，他變得陰沉且令人畏懼...

scripts.text:
[Ghatu]
But I suppose blacksmiths
can never really give up the
hammer. If you can manage to
find him, perhaps you can ask
him to forge something for you?
scripts.translation:
[加圖]
不過我想，鐵匠終究無法放下手中的錘子。如果你能找到他，或許可以請他為你打造點什麼？

scripts.text:
[Ghatu]
Remember that blacksmith
I told you about last time? It
seems that his weapons were
in such great demand because
he would enchant them with 
tremendously powerful magic.
scripts.translation:
[加圖]
還記得我之前跟你提過的那位鐵匠嗎？他的武器之所以如此搶手，是因為他會用極其強大的魔法為武器附魔。

scripts.text:
[Ghatu]
However, the man was forced
by the power hungry and the
oppressive to create weapons
for selfish and immoral ends.
It's no surprise that he went
into hiding in the end...
scripts.translation:
[加圖]
然而，他被迫為那些貪婪且專橫的人制造武器，用於自私且不道德的目的。最後他選擇隱居，這並不令人意外...

scripts.text:
[Ghatu]
It's sad, really.
That smith used to be
a pretty easy going guy
until he was forced to work
against his will. Slowly, he became gloomy and intimidating...
scripts.translation:
[加圖]
真令人難過。
那位鐵匠原本是個挺隨和的傢伙，直到被迫違背意願工作。慢慢地，他變得陰沉且令人畏懼...

scripts.text:
[Ghatu]
But I suppose blacksmiths
can never really give up the
hammer. If you can manage to
find him, perhaps you can ask
him to forge something for you?
scripts.translation:
[加圖]
不過我想，鐵匠終究無法放下手中的錘子。如果你能找到他，或許可以請他為你打造點什麼？

scripts.text:
[Ghatu]
That mysterious blacksmith...
I wonder how he made those
enchanted weapons of his.
I've heard that he might have
been dabbling in the dark arts,
but that doesn't seem right...
scripts.translation:
[加圖]
那位神秘的鐵匠...
我很好奇他是怎麼打造出那些附魔武器的。
聽說他可能在鑽研黑暗魔法，但這似乎不太對勁...

scripts.text:
[Veeyop]
You know, talking
about Mysteltainn and
the death of Baldur just...
It didn't occur to me until
now just how morbid it all
sounds. Yeah, yeah, I know.
scripts.translation:
[維約普]
你知道嗎，談論弒神者和巴爾德爾之死...
直到現在我才知道這一切聽起來多麼陰森。是的，是的，我知道。

scripts.text:
[Veeyop]
Have you heard the
legend of Mysteltainn?
It's a tree, known for being
the only thing able to harm
Baldur, god of light. In fact,
just a twig from it killed him.
scripts.translation:
[維約普]
你聽說過弒神者的傳說嗎？
它是一棵樹，以能夠傷害光之神巴爾德爾而聞名。事實上，僅僅一根樹枝就殺死了他。

scripts.text:
[Veeyop]
Now, I'm not sure if this
is true, but I've heard that
someone actually forged
a sword so powerful, it's
worthy of the name,
''Mysteltainn.''
scripts.translation:
[維約普]
我不確定這是不是真的，但我聽說有人打造了一把極其強大的劍，足以配得上“弒神者”這個名字。

scripts.text:
[Veeyop]
There's only one person
in the world who can forge
that Mysteltainn sword. I...
I think he used to live in
Prontera, but then he moved
away for some weird reason.
scripts.translation:
[維約普]
世界上只有一個人能打造那把弒神者之劍。我...
我想他以前住在普隆德拉，後來因為某些奇怪的原因搬走了。

scripts.text:
[Cetsu]
I keep thinking about
Grimtooth, and it occurred
to me that the spell used to
to endow that dagger with its
strength probably isn't magic
that we're familiar with.
scripts.translation:
[塞茨]
我一直在想魔短劍 闇噬，我意識到賦予這把短劍力量的咒語，可能不是我們熟悉的魔法。

scripts.text:
[Cetsu]
There's all sorts of
creepy stories going
around. I even hear
that the Grimtooth
might have some
sort of weird curse?
scripts.translation:
[塞茨]
到處流傳著各種詭異的故事。我甚至聽說魔短劍 闇噬可能帶有某種奇怪的詛咒？

scripts.text:
[Cetsu]
You know, there are
stories of an incredibly
powerful dagger that's
stronger than steel.
I think it was made
out of ogre teeth?
scripts.translation:
[塞茨]
你知道嗎，有關於一把極其強大的短劍的故事，它比鋼鐵還要堅硬。我想它是用食人魔的牙齒製成的？

scripts.text:
[Cetsu]
Anyway, it wasn't just
the ogre teeth that gave
the dagger its power. I think
it had to be enchanted with
a special spell or something.
scripts.translation:
[塞茨]
總之，賦予這把短劍力量的不僅僅是食人魔的牙齒。我想它一定被施加了某種特殊的咒語之類的東西。

scripts.text:
[Cetsu]
This dagger, the Grimtooth,
can only be made by one person
in the entire world. This guy used to live in Prontera, but then he
moved away for some reason.
scripts.translation:
[塞茨]
這把魔短劍 闇噬，全世界只有一個人能打造。這傢伙以前住在普隆德拉，後來因為某些原因搬走了。

scripts.text:
[Cetsu]
I wonder...
Did he go into
hiding? His weapons
did seem to be pretty
high in demand back then...
scripts.translation:
[塞茨]
我在想...
他是不是隱居了？
當時他的武器似乎很搶手...

scripts.text:
[Nain]
It doesn't matter how
powerful the Executioner
is: if it were to end up in
my hands, I would get rid
of it right away. I'd never risk losing my mind to that curse...
scripts.translation:
[奈恩]
無論行刑者多麼強大：如果它落入我手中，我會立刻處理掉它。我絕不會冒失去理智的風險去承受那個詛咒...

scripts.text:
[Nain]
Long ago, one sword
was used to behead all
the criminals that had been
sentenced to death. That
accursed blade is known
as the Executioner.
scripts.translation:
[奈恩]
很久以前，有一把劍被用來斬首所有被判處死刑的罪犯。那把被詛咒的 blade 被稱為行刑者。

scripts.text:
[Nain]
As the Executioner slayed
more criminals, the rage and
bloodlust of its victims began
to accumulate upon the blade.
Although the sword gained great strength, it was tainted by evil.
scripts.translation:
[奈恩]
隨著行刑者斬殺了更多的罪犯，受害者們的憤怒和嗜血開始積聚在劍身上。雖然這把劍獲得了強大的力量，但它也被邪惡所汙染。

scripts.text:
[Nain]
The last person to wield
the Executioner almost lost
his mind to the sword. He saved himself by giving it to a talented
blacksmith who would destroy it for him, thus saving his soul.
scripts.translation:
[奈恩]
上一個使用行刑者的人幾乎被劍奪去了理智。他為了自救，將劍交給了一位技藝高超的鐵匠將其銷燬，從而拯救了自己的靈魂。

scripts.text:
[Nain]
This mysterious blacksmith
was never seen again in the
city of Prontera, but rumor has
it that if you can find him, he
can forge that accursed
Executioner anew...
scripts.translation:
[奈恩]
這位神秘的鐵匠從此再也沒有出現在普隆德拉城中，但傳聞說，如果你能找到他，他就能重新鍛造那把被詛咒的行刑者...

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Man]
Hold it.
You're carrying
far too many items
with you. Speak to me
after you've placed your
goods into Kafra Storage.
scripts.translation:
[神秘的男子]
站住。
你身上攜帶的物品太多了。先把你的東西存入卡普拉倉庫，再來跟我對話。

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Man]
Well...?
What the hell
are you looking at?
scripts.translation:
[神秘的男子]
怎麼？
你在那看什麼？

scripts.text: Have you heard of the Doomed Swords?
scripts.translation: 你聽說過命運之劍嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Man]
...!
How the hell would
I know about that?
Leave me alone!
scripts.translation:
[神秘的男子]
...！
我怎麼會知道那種東西？
別纏著我！

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Man]
...
scripts.translation:
[神秘的男子]
...

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Man]
...
......

[Mysterious Man]
Get lost.
scripts.translation:
[神秘的男子]
滾開。

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Man]
Well...?
What the hell
are you looking at?
scripts.translation:
[神秘的男子]
怎麼？
你在那看什麼？

scripts.text: Um, er...
scripts.translation: 呃，那個...

scripts.text: Nothing, sir.
scripts.translation: 沒什麼，先生。

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Man]
What...?!
scripts.translation:
[神秘的男子]
什...麼？！

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis guy is
really intimidating!^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF這傢伙看起來真的很嚇人！^000000

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Man]
Nothing, huh?
Well, right now, I'm
looking at a bothersome
adventurer! Get outta here
and leave me the hell alone!
scripts.translation:
[神秘的男子]
沒什麼，是嗎？
哼，現在我看清楚了，你就是一個令人討厭的冒險者！給我滾出去，別再來煩我！

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Man]
Well...?
What the hell
are you looking at?
scripts.translation:
[神秘的男子]
怎麼？
你在那看什麼？

scripts.text: Do you happen to be a blacksmith?
scripts.translation: 你難道就是鐵匠？

scripts.text: No-Nothing!
scripts.translation: 不-不是！

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Blacksmith]
Hmpf. So you're not
a total fool after all. Yes,
I used to do smithing, but
I don't do the simple work
that most Blacksmiths
can do nowadays...
scripts.translation:
[神秘的鐵匠]
哼。看來你也不完全是個傻瓜。是的，我以前確實從事鍛造工作，但我現在不做那些普通鐵匠都能做的簡單活兒了...

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Blacksmith]
...
......

[Mysterious Blacksmith]
Get outta my sight.
scripts.translation:
[神秘的鐵匠]
別讓我再看見你。

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Blacksmith]
Well...?
What the hell
are you looking at?
scripts.translation:
[神秘的鐵匠]
哼...？
你在那看什麼？

scripts.text: I want you to make me a Doomed Sword.
scripts.translation: 我想讓你為我打造一把魔劍。

scripts.text: Er, nothing!
scripts.translation: 呃，沒什麼！

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Blacksmith]
Hm. I don't know where
the hell you may have heard
of me, but I guess one of you
adventurers would find me soon
enough. Now, which doomed
sword did you wish to possess?
scripts.translation:
[神秘的鐵匠]
嗯。我不知道你從哪裡聽說了我的事，但我想你們這些冒險者遲早會找到我。那麼，你想擁有哪一把魔劍？

scripts.text: Mysteltainn.
scripts.translation: 妖劍 弒光

scripts.text: Grimtooth.
scripts.translation: 魔短劍 闇噬

scripts.text: Executioner.
scripts.translation: 行刑者

scripts.text: I ch-changed my mind!
scripts.translation: 我...我改變主意了！

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Blacksmith]
You want...
that sword?
Don't speak its
name so lightly!
scripts.translation:
[神秘的鐵匠]
你想要...
那把劍？
不要如此輕率地
說出它的名字！

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Blacksmith]
Do you understand the curse
on that sword? The Mysteltainn
derives its dark power from the
twig that was used to kill Baldur, god of light. Let me relate the
story as briefly as I can...
scripts.translation:
[神秘的鐵匠]
你知道那把劍上的詛咒嗎？妖劍 弒光的力量源自那根用來殺死光之神巴爾德的樹枝。讓我儘量簡短地講述這個故事...

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Blacksmith]
In the era of the gods,
the beautiful, pure and
joyful Baldur was loved by
all living creatures, save for
one: Loki, the god of trickery.
scripts.translation:
[神秘的鐵匠]
在眾神時代，美麗、純潔且充滿歡樂的巴爾德受到所有生靈的喜愛，除了一個：詭計之神洛基。

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Blacksmith]
When Loki, out of jealousy,
decided to kill Baldur, the
goddess Freyja had a dream
about Baldur's death. Fearing
the realization of her dream,
she counseled with the gods.
scripts.translation:
[神秘的鐵匠]
當洛基出於嫉妒決定殺死巴爾德時，女神弗蕾雅做了一個關於巴爾德死亡的夢。害怕夢境成真，她與眾神商議對策。

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Blacksmith]
To protect Baldur, the gods
decided to extract an oath
to never harm Baldur from
every creature, object and
natural force. All who were
asked agreed to make this oath.
scripts.translation:
[神秘的鐵匠]
為了保護巴爾德，眾神決定讓所有生物、物體和自然力量發誓永不傷害巴爾德。所有被詢問的物件都同意了這一誓言。

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Blacksmith]
Of all the beings and objects
in the universe, Freya only
neglected to ask one tree to
make this oath: the Mysteltainn. Freyja believed it was far too
small and insignificant to ask.
scripts.translation:
[神秘的鐵匠]
在宇宙萬物中，弗蕾雅只遺漏了一棵樹沒有詢問誓言：妖樹。弗蕾雅認為它太小、太微不足道，不值得詢問。

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Blacksmith]
Believing that everything
in the universe had sworn
not to harm Baldur, the gods
made it their new pastime to
throw daggers and knives at
the now nigh invincible god.
scripts.translation:
[神秘的鐵匠]
眾神相信宇宙萬物都發誓不會傷害巴爾德，於是他們開始把向這位近乎無敵的神祇投擲短劍和匕首當作新的消遣。

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Blacksmith]
However, Loki was determined
to kill Baldur and, disguising
himself, politely asked Freyja
if there was any object in the
world that did not take the
oath to not harm Baldur.
scripts.translation:
[神秘的鐵匠]
然而，洛基決心要殺死巴爾德。他偽裝身份，禮貌地詢問弗蕾雅世界上是否有哪個物體沒有立下不傷害巴爾德的誓言。

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Blacksmith]
Freyja suspected nothing and
told Loki about the secret of
Mysteltainn. The next time the gods played their game of throwing
objects at Baldur, Loki was there with a small Mysteltainn twig.
scripts.translation:
[神秘的鐵匠]
弗蕾雅毫無察覺，向洛基透露了妖樹的秘密。下一次眾神玩投擲遊戲時，洛基帶著一小截妖樹枝出現了。

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Blacksmith]
Then, to compound his
treachery, Loki tricked
Hod, Baldur's blind twin
brother, into throwing the
twig into Baldur's heart. And
so, the god of light was slain.
scripts.translation:
[神秘的鐵匠]
為了加重他的背叛，洛基欺騙了巴爾德失明的雙胞胎兄弟霍德，讓他將樹枝刺入巴爾德的心臟。就這樣，光之神被殺死了。

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Blacksmith]
Over the years,
Mysteltainn has been
fashioned into the sword
that you may be familiar
with today. Its power is
strictly forbidden by the gods.
scripts.translation:
[神秘的鐵匠]
多年來，妖樹被打造成了你們今天可能熟悉的那把劍。它的力量被眾神嚴格禁止。

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Blacksmith]
However, if you're willing
to risk that sword's curse
for the sake of its power,
I will forge it for you if you
can bring me the following
items. They'll make sense...
scripts.translation:
[神秘的鐵匠]
不過，如果你願意為了它的力量而承擔那把劍的詛咒，只要你帶來以下物品，我就為你鍛造它。你會明白的...

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Blacksmith]
^0099FF1 Young Twig^000000,
^0099FF1 Emperium^000000,
^0099FF1 Loki's Whispers^000000,
^0099FF1 Mother's Nightmare^000000 and
^0099FF1 Foolishness of the Blind^000000.
That is what I need.

[Mysterious Blacksmith]
I'm not asking for much.
You are only bringing the raw
materials to forge the sword,
and an Emperium to prove your
worthiness to me. I will wait
for your return, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[神秘的鐵匠]
我並沒有要求太多。
你只需要帶來鍛造劍所需的原材料，
以及一塊華麗金屬來證明你的資格。
我會等待你的歸來，冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Blacksmith]
Just by looking at you,
I can tell that you don't know
enough about the Mysteltainn
to fully understand all of the
risks that come with wielding that sword. Yes, you're too green.
scripts.translation:
[神秘的鐵匠]
僅憑看你的樣子，
我就知道你對妖劍 弒光了解得還不夠，
無法完全理解揮舞那把劍所帶來的所有風險。
是的，你太嫩了。

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Blacksmith]
I can't take the risk
of creating that accursed
sword for you if you haven't
learned enough about it to
be fully prepared for any of
the consequences...
scripts.translation:
[神秘的鐵匠]
如果你沒有學到足夠的知識，
無法為任何後果做好充分準備，
我就不能冒為你打造那把被詛咒之劍的風險...

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Blacksmith]
Ah, yes. You must be
wondering how such a small
dagger can contain such power.
It's simple. I cast forbidden
curse magic to inbue the dagger with its awesome destructiveness.
scripts.translation:
[神秘的鐵匠]
啊，是的。你一定很想知道
這樣一把小小的短劍為何蘊含如此強大的力量。
很簡單。我施放了禁忌的詛咒魔法，
賦予了短劍驚人的破壞力。

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Blacksmith]
The curse I cast is so
powerful that if I use it on
a metal dagger, it would
immediately melt down. Ogre
tooth is the only material that
can withstand the curse magic.
scripts.translation:
[神秘的鐵匠]
我施放的詛咒如此強大，
如果用在金屬短劍上，
它會立刻熔化。巨魔之牙是唯一能
承受詛咒魔法的材料。

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Blacksmith]
Of course, it's only
fair to warn you that
the power of the curse
is such that the more you
use the Grimtooth, the more it burns away at your very soul...
scripts.translation:
[神秘的鐵匠]
當然，公平起見，我要警告你，
詛咒的力量如此之大，
你越是使用魔短劍 闇噬，
它就越會灼燒你的靈魂...

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Blacksmith]
I am willing to forge
the Grimtooth if you can
prove worthy to wield its
power and provide all of the
materials I need to create it.
scripts.translation:
[神秘的鐵匠]
如果你能證明你有資格揮舞它的力量，
並提供我打造魔短劍 闇噬所需的所有材料，
我願意為你鍛造它。

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Blacksmith]
I will need...
^0099FF1 Emperium^000000,
^0099FF100 Ogre Teeth^000000,
^0099FF10 Blades of Darkness^000000,
^0099FF5 Cursed Rubies^000000 and
^0099FF1 Broken Sword Handle^000000.

[Mysterious Blacksmith]
I don't need the
Emperium to create
the accursed sword, but I do
require you to prove that you
are worthy of the Grimtooth's
power. Can you truly handle it?
scripts.translation:
[神秘的鐵匠]
打造那把被詛咒之劍並不需要華麗金屬，
但我要求你證明你有資格擁有魔短劍 闇噬的力量。
你真的能駕馭它嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Blacksmith]
Hmpf. You don't really
know what you're asking
for, do you? I won't create
that kind of weapon for any
ignorant fool. Learn more about
Grimtooth before you ask again!
scripts.translation:
[神秘的鐵匠]
哼。你根本不知道自己在要求什麼，
對吧？我不會為任何無知的傻瓜打造那種武器。
在再次詢問之前，先多瞭解一些關於魔短劍 闇噬的事吧！

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Blacksmith]
So you're telling me that
you want a sword that's been
cursed by all the souls that've
died from the thousands of death sentences it has carried out?
Ha ha ha! Very interesting!
scripts.translation:
[神秘的鐵匠]
所以你是說，你想要一把被所有因它執行了數千次死刑而死亡的靈魂所詛咒的劍？
哈哈哈！非常有意思！

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Blacksmith]
Yes... Each time this
sword cut down a guilty
criminal, the blade was
cursed by the rage and
regret of the slain.
scripts.translation:
[神秘的鐵匠]
是的...每次這把劍斬殺有罪的犯人，
劍刃就會被被殺者的憤怒和悔恨所詛咒。

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Blacksmith]
Over time, the Executioner
accumulated a truly dreadful
power from the hatred of those
it had killed. However, he who
uses this sword risks becoming consumed by insanity and hatred.
scripts.translation:
[神秘的鐵匠]
隨著時間推移，行刑者從它所殺之人的仇恨中
積累了真正可怕的力量。然而，使用這把劍的人
有被瘋狂和仇恨吞噬的風險。

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Blacksmith]
The last person for whom
I created this sword asked
me to destroy it, fearing that
it would corrupt his mind with
its bloodlust. But if you think you can endure, I may forge it...
scripts.translation:
[神秘的鐵匠]
最後一個讓我打造這把劍的人
要求我銷燬它，因為他擔心它會用嗜血腐蝕他的心智。
但如果你認為你能忍受，我或許可以為你鍛造...

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Blacksmith]
Just bring me...
^0099FF50 Amulets^000000,
^0099FF1 Emperium^000000,
^0099FF2 Executioner's Gloves^000000,
^0099FF10 Bloody Edges^000000 and
^0099FF3 Necklaces of Oblivion^000000.

[Mysterious Blacksmith]
Those are the items I need
to create a sword imbued with
evil power. As for the Emperium, consider it my test to see if you
are truly capable of wielding
the accursed Executioner...
scripts.translation:
[神秘的鐵匠]
這些是我打造一把蘊含邪惡力量之劍所需的物品。
至於華麗金屬，請把它當作我的考驗，看看你是否真的有能力揮舞被詛咒的行刑者...

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Blacksmith]
Do you even know what
you are asking of me...?
Fool! Go and learn more
about the Executioner! Then,
maybe you'll understand how
dangerous that sword truly is!
scripts.translation:
[神秘的鐵匠]
你甚至知道你在要求我做什麼嗎...？
傻瓜！去多瞭解一些關於行刑者的事吧！
那樣，也許你就會明白那把劍究竟有多危險了！

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Blacksmith]
Hmm...?
That a fact?
scripts.translation:
[神秘的鐵匠]
嗯...？
那是事實嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Blacksmith]
Hmmm...
Have you brought
the required items?
Or did you forget what
you needed to bring to me?
scripts.translation:
[神秘的鐵匠]
嗯...
你帶來所需的物品了嗎？
還是你忘了需要給我帶什麼？

scripts.text: Er, what were the items again?
scripts.translation: 呃，需要哪些物品來著？

scripts.text: Yes, I brought all the required items.
scripts.translation: 是的，我帶來了所有需要的物品。

scripts.text: Oh! Um, never mind!
scripts.translation: 啊！呃，算了！

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Blacksmith]
Hmpf. I thought so.
Now, which sword did
you want me to forge?
scripts.translation:
[神秘的鐵匠]
哼。我就知道。
那麼，你想讓我打造哪把劍？

scripts.text: Mysteltainn.
scripts.translation: 妖劍 弒光

scripts.text: Grimtooth.
scripts.translation: 魔短劍 闇噬

scripts.text: Executioner.
scripts.translation: 行刑者

scripts.text: Wait! I just remembered!
scripts.translation: 等等！我突然想起來了！

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Blacksmith]
^0099FF1 Young Twig^000000,
^0099FF1 Emperium^000000,
^0099FF1 Loki's Whispers^000000,
^0099FF1 Mother's Nightmare^000000 and
^0099FF1 Foolishness of the Blind^000000.
That is what I need.

[Mysterious Blacksmith]
Hmm. You don't understand
enough about Mysteltainn for
me to risk forging that sword
for you. Think again: which
sword did you ask me to create?
scripts.translation:
[神秘的鐵匠]
嗯。你對妖劍 弒光了解得還不夠，
我不敢冒險為你打造那把劍。
再想想：你讓我打造的是哪把劍？

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Blacksmith]
I will need...
^0099FF1 Emperium^000000,
^0099FF100 Ogre Teeth^000000,
^0099FF10 Blades of Darkness^000000,
^0099FF5 Cursed Rubies^000000 and
^0099FF1 Broken Sword Handle^000000.

[Mysterious Blacksmith]
Hmm. You don't know enough
about the Grimtooth for me to
risk forging it for you. Learn
more about that dagger if you
really want to possess it...
scripts.translation:
[神秘的鐵匠]
嗯。你對魔短劍 闇噬瞭解得還不夠，
我不敢冒險為你打造它。
如果你真的想擁有它，
就去多瞭解一些關於那把短劍的事吧...

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Blacksmith]
Just bring me...
^0099FF50 Amulets^000000,
^0099FF1 Emperium^000000,
^0099FF2 Executioner's Gloves^000000,
^0099FF10 Bloody Edges^000000 and
^0099FF3 Necklaces of Oblivion^000000.

[Mysterious Blacksmith]
You don't know anything
about the Executioner. Learn
more about that sword before
you consider asking me to
forge that monstrocity.
scripts.translation:
[神秘的鐵匠]
你對行刑者一無所知。
在考慮讓我打造那把怪物般的劍之前，
先去多瞭解一些關於它的事吧。

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Blacksmith]
Fine.
Then bring all
the items I require
when you are ready.
scripts.translation:
[神秘的鐵匠]
好吧。
那麼，當你準備好時，
請帶來我所需的所有物品。

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Blacksmith]
So you think you're
ready. Now, which sword
did you want me to craft?
scripts.translation:
[神秘的鐵匠]
看來你覺得自己準備好了。
那麼，你想讓我打造哪把劍？

scripts.text: Mysteltainn
scripts.translation: 妖劍 弒光

scripts.text: Grimtooth
scripts.translation: 魔短劍 闇噬

scripts.text: Executioner
scripts.translation: 行刑者

scripts.text: I ch-changed my mind!
scripts.translation: 我...我改變主意了！

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Blacksmith]
Mysteltainn. Hm.
Let me make sure
that you brought
everything I need to
create this sword...
scripts.translation:
[神秘的鐵匠]
妖劍 弒光。嗯。
讓我確認一下，
你是否帶來了打造這把劍
所需的一切...

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Blacksmith]
Well, well.
You've forgotten
to bring ^0099FF1 Young Twig^000000,
the embodiment of the
Mysteltainn twig used to kill Baldur. Hurry and bring it...
scripts.translation:
[神秘的鐵匠]
哎呀。
你忘了帶^0099FF1小樹枝^000000，
那是用來殺死巴爾德的
妖劍 弒光樹枝的化身。快去把它找來...

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Blacksmith]
Hm. You forgot to bring
^0099FF1 Loki's Whispers^000000. We need
that to imbue the sword with
immense, evil power. Go and
find that as quickly as you can!
scripts.translation:
[神秘的鐵匠]
嗯，你忘了帶^0099FF1傲慢之像^000000。
我們需要它來賦予劍
巨大的邪惡力量。快去把它找來！

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Blacksmith]
Hm, you still need to
bring ^0099FF1 Mother's Nightmare^000000
to instill the power of misery
and grave portent to this blade...
scripts.translation:
[神秘的鐵匠]
嗯，你還需要帶^0099FF1惡夢之石^000000，
以將痛苦和厄運的力量
注入這把劍中...

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Blacksmith]
Hm, you still need to
bring ^0099FF1 Foolishness
of the Blind^000000 to instill the
energy of tragic regret into
the curse imbued into the blade...
scripts.translation:
[神秘的鐵匠]
嗯，你還需要帶^0099FF1盲者的愚行^000000，
以將悲劇悔恨的能量
注入注入劍中的詛咒裡...

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Blacksmith]
You have everything
I require to forge the
Mysteltainn, but you must
still prove yourself capable
of wielding it. Bring ^0099FF1 Emperium^000000 and I will recognize your worth.
scripts.translation:
[神秘的鐵匠]
你已經帶來了打造妖劍 弒光
所需的一切，但你必須
證明自己有資格揮舞它。
帶來^0099FF1華麗金屬^000000，
我將認可你的價值。

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Blacksmith]
Well done, adventurer.
All seems to be in readiness.
Give me a minute to summon
the dark power to forge the
forbidden sword, Mysteltainn.
scripts.translation:
[神秘的鐵匠]
幹得好，冒險者。
一切似乎都準備就緒了。
給我一點時間，
我將召喚黑暗靈魂之力，
打造這把禁忌之劍，妖劍 弒光。

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Blacksmith]
I... I never thought
I would ever see this
sword again. Take it,
quickly! I d-don't want
to touch it if I can avoid it.
scripts.translation:
[神秘的鐵匠]
我...我從未想過
還能再次見到這把劍。
拿著，快拿走！
我...我不想碰它，如果我能避免的話。

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Blacksmith]
Be very careful.
Don't let yourself
be consumed by the
power of that sword!
By all means, resist
Mysteltainn's tragic curse!
scripts.translation:
[神秘的鐵匠]
務必小心。
千萬不要被那把劍的力量吞噬！
無論如何，都要抵抗妖劍 弒光那悲慘的詛咒！

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Blacksmith]
You want...
that sword?
Don't speak its
name so lightly!
scripts.translation:
[神秘的鐵匠]
你想要...
那把劍？
不要如此輕率地
說出它的名字！

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Blacksmith]
Do you understand the curse
on that sword? The Mysteltainn
derives its dark power from the
twig that was used to kill Baldur, god of light. Let me relate the
story as briefly as I can...
scripts.translation:
[神秘的鐵匠]
你知道那把劍上的詛咒嗎？妖劍 弒光的力量源自那根用來殺死光之神巴爾德的樹枝。讓我儘量簡短地講述這個故事...

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Blacksmith]
In the era of the gods,
the beautiful, pure and
joyful Baldur was loved by
all living creatures, save for
one: Loki, the god of trickery.
scripts.translation:
[神秘的鐵匠]
在眾神時代，美麗、純潔且充滿歡樂的巴爾德受到所有生靈的喜愛，除了一個：詭計之神洛基。

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Blacksmith]
When Loki, out of jealousy,
decided to kill Baldur, the
goddess Freyja had a dream
about Baldur's death. Fearing
the realization of her dream,
she counseled with the gods.
scripts.translation:
[神秘的鐵匠]
當洛基出於嫉妒決定殺死巴爾德時，女神弗蕾雅做了一個關於巴爾德死亡的夢。害怕夢境成真，她與眾神商議對策。

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Blacksmith]
To protect Baldur, the gods
decided to extract an oath
to never harm Baldur from
every creature, object and
natural force. All who were
asked agreed to make this oath.
scripts.translation:
[神秘的鐵匠]
為了保護巴爾德，眾神決定讓所有生物、物體和自然力量發誓永不傷害巴爾德。所有被詢問的物件都同意了這一誓言。

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Blacksmith]
Of all the beings and objects
in the universe, Freya only
neglected to ask one tree to
make this oath: the Mysteltainn. Freyja believed it was far too
small and insignificant to ask.
scripts.translation:
[神秘的鐵匠]
在宇宙萬物中，弗蕾雅只遺漏了一棵樹沒有詢問誓言：妖樹。弗蕾雅認為它太小、太微不足道，不值得詢問。

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Blacksmith]
Believing that everything
in the universe had sworn
not to harm Baldur, the gods
made it their new pastime to
throw daggers and knives at
the now nigh invincible god.
scripts.translation:
[神秘的鐵匠]
眾神相信宇宙萬物都發誓不會傷害巴爾德，於是他們開始把向這位近乎無敵的神祇投擲短劍和匕首當作新的消遣。

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Blacksmith]
However, Loki was determined
to kill Baldur and, disguising
himself, politely asked Freyja
if there was any object in the
world that did not take the
oath to not harm Baldur.
scripts.translation:
[神秘的鐵匠]
然而，洛基決心要殺死巴爾德。他偽裝身份，禮貌地詢問弗蕾雅世界上是否有哪個物體沒有立下不傷害巴爾德的誓言。

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Blacksmith]
Freyja suspected nothing and
told Loki about the secret of
Mysteltainn. The next time the gods played their game of throwing
objects at Baldur, Loki was there with a small Mysteltainn twig.
scripts.translation:
[神秘的鐵匠]
弗蕾雅毫無察覺，向洛基透露了妖樹的秘密。下一次眾神玩投擲遊戲時，洛基帶著一小截妖樹枝出現了。

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Blacksmith]
Then, to compound his
treachery, Loki tricked
Hod, Baldur's blind twin
brother, into throwing the
twig into Baldur's heart. And
so, the god of light was slain.
scripts.translation:
[神秘的鐵匠]
為了加重他的背叛，洛基欺騙了巴爾德失明的雙胞胎兄弟霍德，讓他將樹枝刺入巴爾德的心臟。就這樣，光之神被殺死了。

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Blacksmith]
Over the years,
Mysteltainn has been
fashioned into the sword
that you may be familiar
with today. Its power is
strictly forbidden by the gods.
scripts.translation:
[神秘的鐵匠]
多年來，妖樹被打造成了你們今天可能熟悉的那把劍。它的力量被眾神嚴格禁止。

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Blacksmith]
However, if you're willing
to risk that sword's curse
for the sake of its power,
I will forge it for you if you
can bring me the following
items. They'll make sense...
scripts.translation:
[神秘的鐵匠]
不過，如果你願意為了它的力量而承擔那把劍的詛咒，只要你帶來以下物品，我就為你鍛造它。你會明白的...

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Blacksmith]
^0099FF1 Young Twig^000000,
^0099FF1 Emperium^000000,
^0099FF1 Loki's Whispers^000000,
^0099FF1 Mother's Nightmare^000000 and
^0099FF1 Foolishness of the Blind^000000.
That is what I need.

[Mysterious Blacksmith]
I'm not asking for much.
You are only bringing the raw
materials to forge the sword,
and an Emperium to prove your
worthiness to me. I will wait
for your return, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[神秘的鐵匠]
我並沒有要求太多。
你只需要帶來鍛造劍所需的原材料，
以及一塊華麗金屬來證明你的資格。
我會等待你的歸來，冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Blacksmith]
Hm. If you truly want
Mysteltainn, I advise you
to learn more about it. You
must know the risks involved
in wielding that sort of power...
scripts.translation:
[神秘的鐵匠]
嗯。如果你真的想要妖劍 弒光，
我建議你多瞭解一些關於它的資訊。
你必須知道揮舞那種力量所伴隨的風險...

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Blacksmith]
You want to me
to forge Grimtooth.
First, let me check
if you brought all
the items I require.
scripts.translation:
[神秘的鐵匠]
你想讓我打造魔短劍 闇噬。
首先，讓我檢查一下
你是否帶來了
我所需的所有材料。

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Blacksmith]
Hm. I still need
^0099FF100 Ogre Teeth^000000 to
create a blade that can
withstand the might of the
Grimtooth's curse magic.
Go and bring them soon.
scripts.translation:
[神秘的鐵匠]
嗯。我還需要
^0099FF100 食人魔牙齒^000000，
才能打造出能承受
魔短劍 闇噬詛咒魔法威力的刀刃。
快去把它們帶回來。

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Blacksmith]
In order to place
the curse that grants
the Grimtooth its immense
power, I need you to bring
^0099FF5 Cursed Rubies^000000. Hurry
and bring them to me soon.
scripts.translation:
[神秘的鐵匠]
為了施加賦予魔短劍 闇噬
巨大力量的詛咒，
我需要你帶來
^0099FF5 詛咒紅寶石^000000。
快一點把它們帶給我。

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Blacksmith]
Hm. I still need
^0099FF10 Blades of Darkness^000000
in order to for me to forge
the Grimtooth. Bring those
here as soon as you can.
scripts.translation:
[神秘的鐵匠]
嗯。我還需要
^0099FF10 黑暗之刃^000000，
才能為你打造魔短劍 闇噬。
儘快把它們帶過來。

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Blacksmith]
Hm. You almost have
everything ready, but
I'll need ^0099FF1 Broken Sword
Handle^000000 in order to forge
the Grimtooth. Hurry and
bring me one of those...
scripts.translation:
[神秘的鐵匠]
嗯。你幾乎準備好了所有材料，
但我還需要^0099FF1 破裂之劍柄^000000
才能打造魔短劍 闇噬。
快帶一把來...

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Blacksmith]
You have everything I need
to create the sword, but I won't forge it until you prove that you
are capable of controlling its
power. Bring me 1 Emperium
as proof of your worthiness.
scripts.translation:
[神秘的鐵匠]
你已經帶來了打造這把劍所需的一切，
但在你證明自己有資格控制
它的力量之前，我不會打造它。
帶來1個華麗金屬，
以證明你的價值。

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Blacksmith]
I see that you have
come fully prepared.
Perhaps you have grave
need of Grimtooth's power.
Give me a moment as I forge
this accursed sword for you...
scripts.translation:
[神秘的鐵匠]
看來你已經完全準備好了。
也許你非常需要魔短劍 闇噬的力量。
給我一點時間，
讓我為你打造這把被詛咒的劍...

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Blacksmith]
There, it's finished!
Now hurry and take it!
I, I don't want to handle
the Grimtooth longer than
I have to! You'll understand
soon enough once you use it...
scripts.translation:
[神秘的鐵匠]
好了，完成了！
現在快拿走它！
我...我不想再碰魔短劍 闇噬
超過必要的時間！
等你使用它之後，
很快就會明白的...

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Blacksmith]
I know that you might
have good intentions for
Grimtooth's power, but do
not overestimate yourself!
Always be wary of Grimtooth,
and don't let it eat your soul!
scripts.translation:
[神秘的鐵匠]
我知道你可能對魔短劍 闇噬的力量
抱有善意，但不要高估自己！
時刻警惕魔短劍 闇噬，
不要讓它吞噬你的靈魂！

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Blacksmith]
Ah, yes. You must be
wondering how such a small
dagger can contain such power.
It's simple. I cast forbidden
curse magic to inbue the dagger with its awesome destructiveness.
scripts.translation:
[神秘的鐵匠]
啊，是的。你一定很想知道
這樣一把小小的短劍為何蘊含如此強大的力量。
很簡單。我施放了禁忌的詛咒魔法，
賦予了短劍驚人的破壞力。

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Blacksmith]
The curse I cast is so
powerful that if I use it on
a metal dagger, it would
immediately melt down. Ogre
tooth is the only material that
can withstand the curse magic.
scripts.translation:
[神秘的鐵匠]
我施放的詛咒如此強大，
如果用在金屬短劍上，
它會立刻熔化。巨魔之牙是唯一能
承受詛咒魔法的材料。

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Blacksmith]
Of course, it's only
fair to warn you that
the power of the curse
is such that the more you
use the Grimtooth, the more it burns away at your very soul...
scripts.translation:
[神秘的鐵匠]
當然，公平起見，我要警告你，
詛咒的力量如此之大，
你越是使用魔短劍 闇噬，
它就越會灼燒你的靈魂...

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Blacksmith]
I am willing to forge
the Grimtooth if you can
prove worthy to wield its
power and provide all of the
materials I need to create it.
scripts.translation:
[神秘的鐵匠]
如果你能證明你有資格揮舞它的力量，
並提供我打造魔短劍 闇噬所需的所有材料，
我願意為你鍛造它。

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Blacksmith]
I will need...
^0099FF1 Emperium^000000,
^0099FF100 Ogre Teeth^000000,
^0099FF10 Blades of Darkness^000000,
^0099FF5 Cursed Rubies^000000 and
^0099FF1 Broken Sword Handle^000000.

[Mysterious Blacksmith]
I don't need the
Emperium to create
the accursed sword, but I do
require you to prove that you
are worthy of the Grimtooth's
power. Can you truly handle it?
scripts.translation:
[神秘的鐵匠]
打造那把被詛咒之劍並不需要華麗金屬，
但我要求你證明你有資格擁有魔短劍 闇噬的力量。
你真的能駕馭它嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Blacksmith]
Hm. I can't even consider
forging Grimtooth for you
when you know so very little
about it. You better learn more
about that sword before you
ask me about it again.
scripts.translation:
[神秘的鐵匠]
嗯。既然你對它瞭解得這麼少，
我甚至無法考慮為你打造魔短劍 闇噬。
在你再次向我詢問之前，
最好先多瞭解一下那把劍。

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Blacksmith]
The Executioner sword.
Let me see if you've come
prepared to wield that blade
with your own two hands...
scripts.translation:
[神秘的鐵匠]
行刑者之劍。
讓我看看你是否已經準備好
用雙手揮舞那把刀刃...

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Blacksmith]
Hm. In order for me
to forge the Executioner,
I need you to bring me
^0099FF2 Executioner's Gloves^000000.
scripts.translation:
[神秘的鐵匠]
嗯。為了打造行刑者，
我需要你帶來
^0099FF2 行刑者手套^000000。

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Blacksmith]
In order to craft the
blade, I need at least
^0099FF10 Bloody Edges^000000. Find
those as quickly as you
can and bring them to me.
scripts.translation:
[神秘的鐵匠]
為了打造刀刃，
我至少需要
^0099FF10 血染之刀^000000。
儘快找到它們並帶給我。

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Blacksmith]
In order to enchant
the Executioner with
its dark power, I will
need you to bring me
^0099FF3 Necklaces of Oblivion^000000.
Go, hurry and get them!
scripts.translation:
[神秘的鐵匠]
為了用黑暗靈魂之力
為行刑者附魔，
我需要你帶來
^0099FF3 遺忘項鍊^000000。
去吧，快去把它們找來！

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Blacksmith]
Hm. You've forgotten to
bring me ^0099FF50 Amulets^000000. I need
those in order to imbue the
incredible energies that
give the Executioner its
monstrous strength...
scripts.translation:
[神秘的鐵匠]
嗯。你忘記帶
^0099FF50 護符^000000了。我需要它們
來注入賦予行刑者
可怕力量的驚人能量...

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Blacksmith]
You have everything I need
to forge the Executioner, but
I'm still unsure of whether you
are capable of handling its
power. My fears will be allayed
if you bring ^0099FF1 Emperium^000000.
scripts.translation:
[神秘的鐵匠]
你已經帶來了打造行刑者所需的一切，
但我仍不確定你是否有能力駕馭
它的力量。如果你帶來
^0099FF1 華麗金屬^000000，
我的擔憂就會消除。

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Blacksmith]
Great, I see that you've
prepared everything that
I asked. Give me a moment
while I summon the dark
forces required to forge
the Executioner...
scripts.translation:
[神秘的鐵匠]
很好，看來你已經
準備了我要求的一切。
給我一點時間，
我將召喚打造行刑者所需的
黑暗靈魂之力...

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Blacksmith]
It's been a long time
since I've seen this
terrifying sword. Now
take it! Be wary, and don't
let its bloodlust consume you!
scripts.translation:
[神秘的鐵匠]
我已經很久沒見過
這把可怕的劍了。現在
拿走它吧！小心，
不要讓它嗜血的本性吞噬你！

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Blacksmith]
So you're telling me that
you want a sword that's been
cursed by all the souls that've
died from the thousands of death sentences it has carried out?
Ha ha ha! Very interesting!
scripts.translation:
[神秘的鐵匠]
所以你是說，你想要一把被所有因它執行了數千次死刑而死亡的靈魂所詛咒的劍？
哈哈哈！非常有意思！

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Blacksmith]
Yes... Each time this
sword cut down a guilty
criminal, the blade was
cursed by the rage and
regret of the slain.
scripts.translation:
[神秘的鐵匠]
是的...每次這把劍斬殺有罪的犯人，
劍刃就會被被殺者的憤怒和悔恨所詛咒。

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Blacksmith]
Over time, the Executioner
accumulated a truly dreadful
power from the hatred of those
it had killed. However, he who
uses this sword risks becoming consumed by insanity and hatred.
scripts.translation:
[神秘的鐵匠]
隨著時間推移，行刑者從它所殺之人的仇恨中
積累了真正可怕的力量。然而，使用這把劍的人
有被瘋狂和仇恨吞噬的風險。

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Blacksmith]
The last person for whom
I created this sword asked
me to destroy it, fearing that
it would corrupt his mind with
its bloodlust. But if you think you can endure, I may forge it...
scripts.translation:
[神秘的鐵匠]
最後一個讓我打造這把劍的人
要求我銷燬它，因為他擔心它會用嗜血腐蝕他的心智。
但如果你認為你能忍受，我或許可以為你鍛造...

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Blacksmith]
Just bring me...
^0099FF50 Amulets^000000,
^0099FF1 Emperium^000000,
^0099FF2 Executioner's Gloves^000000,
^0099FF10 Bloody Edges^000000 and
^0099FF3 Necklaces of Oblivion^000000.

[Mysterious Blacksmith]
Those are the items I need
to create a sword imbued with
evil power. As for the Emperium, consider it my test to see if you
are truly capable of wielding
the accursed Executioner...
scripts.translation:
[神秘的鐵匠]
這些是我打造一把蘊含邪惡力量之劍所需的物品。
至於華麗金屬，請把它當作我的考驗，看看你是否真的有能力揮舞被詛咒的行刑者...

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Blacksmith]
Hmpf. I don't think
you understand enough
about the Executioner to
ask me to forge it. You better
learn more about that accursed
sword if you really want it...
scripts.translation:
[神秘的鐵匠]
哼。我覺得你對行刑者瞭解得還不夠，
就敢讓我為你鍛造它。
如果你真的想要它，
最好先多瞭解一下那把被詛咒的劍...

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Blacksmith]
Hmm...?
That a fact?
scripts.translation:
[神秘的鐵匠]
嗯...？
那是事實嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Blacksmith]
Hmpf...
Well then, come
back when you know
exactly what you want
from me, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[神秘的鐵匠]
哼...
那麼，等你確切知道
想要從我這裡得到什麼時，
再回來吧，冒險者。
